# Assurance

`admin.offering.assurance` · offering_family · parent `—`

> Producing evidence that an obligation has been met. The deliverable is not the activity but the proof of it, which means work performed correctly and undocumented has no value in this service line at all.


## Characteristics

|  |  |
|---|---|
| delivery | evidence, on demand, to a third party |
| pricing_shape | fixed cost per obligation or per cycle |
| margin_profile | dominated by retrieval cost, not by the control itself |
| post_sale_load | high — evidence must survive long after the control ran |
| notes | Consumers: regulators, auditors, boards, insurers and counterparties. Funded by allocated overhead, occasionally recharged to the entity. An internal function with no chargeback has no natural brake on demand, which changes which capabilities matter and is why this line is recorded.  |
